confidence_notes: FX is from one RBA search (18 Nov 2026 observation, 0.6720 USD per AUD). I ran one price search, which returned aggregated cost-of-living data for beer, cappuccino and wine. Those figures came from several sources and years and disagreed with each other. The search found no cocktail prices, so I estimated cocktails from the beer price (about 2x beer). The wine glass is derived from the mid-range bottle price, about $10 per bottle, using restaurant markup. The restaurant meal anchors are rough estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation. Those anchors are holistic model estimates, and the figures are for the July 2026 high season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Riga and Vilnius, with Tallinn's prices slightly higher. Tallinn's restaurant prices are a little below Vienna and Dublin, according to the search results.
